questions.stem: Kate ______ to Beijing three times, but she ______ there last month with her parents.
questions.explanation: 选B。第一空'has been to'表示'去过某地（已经回来）'，强调经历；第二空'went'是一般过去时，后面有具体过去时间状语'last month'，表示过去某个特定时间发生的动作。A选项'has gone to'表示去了还没回来，与'three times'矛盾；C选项时态颠倒；D选项第二空现在完成时不能与'last month'连用。口诀：'has been to表经历，过去式配过去时'。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The man ______ is standing under the big tree is my uncle, who is a doctor.
questions.explanation: 选A。先行词'the man'指人，在定语从句中作主语（is standing），所以用关系代词who。which指物；whom指人但只能作宾语；whose表示'谁的'，在从句中作定语。解题技巧：看空后是否缺主语，缺主语指人用who，指物用which。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These story books ______ to the library already by the students.
questions.explanation: 选C。'already'是现在完成时的标志词，且书是'被归还'，需要用被动语态，所以用现在完成时的被动语态'have been returned'。A选项缺少助动词；B选项是主动语态；D选项是一般过去时被动，与'already'提示的时态不符。技巧：看到'already/yet'想现在完成，看到'by'想被动。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Could you please tell me ______? I need to post a letter.
options: A. where is the nearest post office
B. where the nearest post office is
C. where does the nearest post office
D. where the nearest post office does
questions.explanation: 选B。宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主语+谓语），不能用疑问语序。A选项是疑问语序（is放在主语前）；C和D选项结构错误，从句中缺少谓语动词。技巧：宾语从句用陈述语序，即'引导词+主语+谓语'。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: If you add 'un-' to the word 'happy', you get '______', which means not happy.
questions.explanation: 选B。un-是前缀，表示'不、无'，加在形容词happy前构成反义词unhappy（不开心的），词性仍是形容词。A是副词；C是名词（快乐）；D是名词（不快乐）。注意：前缀un-通常改变词义但不改变词性。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We have to ______ the sports meeting because of the heavy rain tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 选A。put off表示'推迟'，符合句意'因为大雨推迟运动会'。put on表示'穿上、上演'；put up表示'张贴、搭建'；put down表示'放下、记下'。技巧：off有'离开、远离'的含义，put off就是让事情远离原定时间，即推迟。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The little girl was ______ when she saw the snake in the garden; she ran away quickly.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据上下文'snake（蛇）'和'ran away quickly（快速跑开）'可知女孩感到'害怕'。frightened表示'受惊的、害怕的'。excited（兴奋的）、interested（感兴趣的）、bored（无聊的）都不符合语境。解题技巧：利用上下文线索（蛇+逃跑）推断情感态度。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.group_passage:
Our school started a recycling program last month. It has changed the way we deal with waste. Before the program, students threw everything into one bin. Now we have three different bins for paper, plastic and other waste.

At first, many students found it (8)______ to remember which bin to use. Some put food waste into the paper bin. Others were (9)______ about why we needed to separate waste. "It takes too much time," complained Tom.

However, things improved after two weeks. Student volunteers stood near the bins to (10)______ classmates. They explained that recycling helps protect our environment. When we recycle paper, we save trees. When we recycle plastic, we reduce pollution.

Now most students have (11)______ used to the new system. "I feel good knowing I'm helping the planet," said Lily. The program has (12)______ us that small actions can make a big difference.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据下文'Some put food waste into the paper bin（有人把食物垃圾放进纸类垃圾桶）'可知，一开始学生们觉得'很难'记住哪个桶放什么。difficult表示'困难的'。easy（容易的）与文意相反；interesting（有趣的）和boring（无聊的）不符合上下文逻辑。
questions.label: 完形填空

questions.group_passage:
Do you often feel sleepy in class? Many students do, and it's not always because they stayed up late. Scientists have found that our body clocks work differently from school schedules.

Teenagers naturally feel more awake later at night and sleepier in the early morning. This is because the hormone (荷尔蒙) melatonin, which makes us sleepy, is released later in teenage brains than in adult brains.

However, most schools start classes before 8:00 a.m. This means many students are fighting against their natural body clocks when they should be sleeping. Studies show that students who get enough sleep perform better in exams and have better mental health.

Some schools in the US have tried starting classes later, at 9:00 a.m. The results were surprising. Students' grades improved, and there were fewer car accidents involving teenage drivers.

Experts suggest that schools should consider students' biological needs. "Education is important, but so is health," says Dr. Smith, a sleep researcher.
questions.stem: Why do teenagers feel sleepy in the early morning according to the passage?
options: A. Because they stay up late playing computer games.
B. Because their brains release sleep hormone later than adults.
C. Because they don't like going to school early.
D. Because they have too much homework to do at night.
questions.explanation: 选B。细节理解题。根据第二段第二句'This is because the hormone melatonin, which makes us sleepy, is released later in teenage brains than in adult brains.'可知，青少年早上困倦是因为大脑释放褪黑素（睡眠荷尔蒙）的时间比成年人晚。A、C、D选项都不是文中提到的原因。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解

options: A. All schools in the US now start classes at 9:00 a.m.
B. Teenagers should go to bed earlier to solve the problem.
C. Changing school start time may bring benefits to students.
D. Dr. Smith thinks education is more important than health.

questions.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
options: A. How to Sleep Well at Night
B. Teenagers' Body Clocks and School Time
D. How Hormones Work in the Brain
questions.explanation: 选B。主旨大意题。文章主要讨论了青少年的生物钟（褪黑素释放晚导致早上困倦）与学校上课时间（过早开始）之间的矛盾，以及推迟上课时间的可能好处。A选项只涉及睡眠，太宽泛；C选项偏离主题；D选项只是细节。技巧：最佳标题要涵盖全文核心——生物钟与上课时间的关系。

questions.group_passage:
Joining a school club is a great way to make friends and learn new skills. (17)______ Here are some tips to help you choose the right club.

First, think about your interests. Do you enjoy music, sports, or art? (18)______ If you love what you're doing, you'll have more fun and stick with it longer.

Second, consider your schedule. Some clubs meet every day, while others meet once a week. (19)______ Make sure you have enough time for both club activities and homework.

Finally, don't be afraid to try something new. (20)______ You might discover a hidden talent or passion. Remember, the goal is to learn and enjoy yourself, not to be perfect from day one.
options: A. However, it can be hard to decide which one to join.
B. For example, if you like drawing, the art club might be perfect for you.
C. In addition, you should avoid clubs that require too much time.
D. Choose a club that fits your free time.
E. You may feel nervous at first, but that's normal.
questions.explanation: 选A。前文说加入社团很好，后文说'这里有一些建议帮助你选择'，中间需要转折过渡，表示'然而，很难决定加入哪一个'。However表示转折关系，承上启下。B是举例，适合用于兴趣段；C是并列建议，但语气与后文'consider your schedule'重复；D是具体建议；E是鼓励，适合用于最后一段。
